title: Corporation Is a Person

source.release: 2026 Criminal Jury Instructions (as adopted by the Judicial Council, February 2026)

body: (A/The) defendant[s] in this case, ______ <insert name[s] of corporate defendant[s]>, (is a corporation/are corporations). Under the law, a corporation must be treated in the same way as a natural person. When I use words like person or he or she in these instructions to refer to the defendant[s], those instructions [also] apply to ______ <insert name[s] of corporate defendant[s]>.

bench_notes.text: The court has a sua sponte duty to give this instruction if the defendant is a corporation.

authority.text: • Corporation Is a Person. Pen. Code, § 7.
